sentences.zh: 你好，皮特。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Take a seat.
sentences.zh: 请坐。

sentences.en: Make yourself comfortable.
sentences.zh: 请随意些。

sentences.en: A former restaurant critic bearing gifts.
sentences.zh: 一位带着礼物前来的前餐厅评论家。

sentences.en: I've brought you a present.
sentences.zh: 我给你带了件礼物。

sentences.en: Tell me about this present.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说这件礼物吧。

sentences.en: Uh, it's a six-pack of little mini boxes of California raisins.
sentences.zh: 呃，这是一包六盒装的加州葡萄干小盒。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And I thought we could each eat one.
sentences.zh: 我想我们一人可以吃一盒。

sentences.en: Raisin.
sentences.zh: 葡萄干。

sentences.en: Just one?
sentences.zh: 就吃一颗？

sentences.en: One raisin.
sentences.zh: 一颗葡萄干。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: What are we up to here?
sentences.zh: 我们这是在干什么？

sentences.en: This is something that's called the raisin exercise.
sentences.zh: 这叫做葡萄干练习。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's called the raisin meditation because it comes ultimately from a Zen Buddhist perspective on eating.
sentences.zh: 有时也叫葡萄干冥想，因为它最终源于禅宗对饮食的看法。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And the world of mindfulness.
sentences.zh: 以及正念的世界。

sentences.en: So, I hadn't anticipated that that could ever revolve around a raisin.
sentences.zh: 所以，我没料到这竟然会围绕着一颗葡萄干展开。

sentences.en: It can revolve around anything.
sentences.zh: 它可以围绕任何事物展开。

sentences.en: We could be doing this with an M&M.
sentences.zh: 我们也可以用M&M豆来做这个练习。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bovaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·博瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 这是周日版的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm going to open this box of raisins.
sentences.zh: 我要打开这盒葡萄干了。

sentences.en: Recently, I sat down with former Times restaurant critic Pete Wells for a very small meal.
sentences.zh: 最近，我和《时报》前餐厅评论家皮特·威尔斯坐下来吃了一顿非常小的餐。

sentences.en: Can I eat it?
sentences.zh: 我可以吃了吗？

sentences.en: You cannot eat it.
sentences.zh: 你不能吃。

sentences.en: It consisted of one raisin.
sentences.zh: 它只有一颗葡萄干。

sentences.en: You can have more later, but we'll start with one.
sentences.zh: 你以后可以多吃点，但我们先从一颗开始。

sentences.en: First, we looked at this raisin.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们观察了这颗葡萄干。

sentences.en: Lots of veins and ridges.
sentences.zh: 有很多纹路和褶皱。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Then we smelled the raisin.
sentences.zh: 然后我们闻了闻这颗葡萄干。

sentences.en: Let's give it a sniff.
sentences.zh: 让我们闻一下。

sentences.en: Then we took one tiny bite of the raisins.
sentences.zh: 然后我们咬了一小口葡萄干。

sentences.en: I want to keep chewing so badly.
sentences.zh: 我太想继续咀嚼了。

sentences.en: And then finally, and mercifully, we ate it.
sentences.zh: 最后，谢天谢地，我们把它吃了。

sentences.en: What changed?
sentences.zh: 有什么改变吗？

sentences.en: Everything.
sentences.zh: 一切都变了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's unlocked its flavor.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它释放出了它的风味。

sentences.en: All in all, it took us 25 minutes to eat one raisin.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们花了25分钟才吃完一颗葡萄干。

sentences.en: Everything about this violates my sense of how food is to be consumed.
sentences.zh: 这一切都违背了我对食物消费方式的认知。

sentences.en: If it's not already abundantly clear, my colleague Pete Wells, who was the restaurant critic here at the Times for 12 celebrated years,
sentences.zh: 如果还没说清楚的话，我的同事皮特·威尔斯，曾担任《时报》餐厅评论家12年之久，备受赞誉，

sentences.en: he has been on a mission to completely transform his relationship with eating.
sentences.zh: 他一直致力于彻底改变他与饮食的关系。

sentences.en: And this exercise, the raisin meditation, was one way that he learned how to slow down and really pay attention to the food that he was consuming and why he was consuming it.
sentences.zh: 而这个练习，即葡萄干冥想，是他学习如何慢下来，真正关注他所摄入的食物以及为什么要摄入它们的一种方式。

sentences.en: But for Pete, this larger mission, this resetting of his relationship with food, it wasn't about a trendy diet, and it wasn't about losing weight to look better.
sentences.zh: 但对皮特来说，这个更大的使命，即重塑他与食物的关系，并不是为了赶时髦的节食，也不是为了减肥以让自己看起来更好。

sentences.en: It was a matter of life or death.
sentences.zh: 这是关乎生死的问题。

sentences.en: Today, my conversation with Pete Wells about how and why he went from being the king of indulgence to a model of austerity.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与皮特·威尔斯探讨他如何以及为何从放纵之王变成了节制典范。

sentences.en: It's Sunday, March 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月15日，星期日。

sentences.en: Pete, welcome to The Sunday Daily.
sentences.zh: 皮特，欢迎来到周日版《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I just have to say that this single raisin routine, this exercise you put us through,
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，这个单颗葡萄干的流程，这个你让我们做的练习，

sentences.en: it feels very far from the relationship with food that defined the last decade of your life and your career as the restaurant critic for the Times.
sentences.zh: 感觉和你过去十年生活以及作为《时报》餐厅评论家的职业生涯中所定义的饮食关系相去甚远。

sentences.en: And it seems like you're changed.
sentences.zh: 看起来你变了。

sentences.en: Well, I used to eat a lot more than one raisin.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我以前吃的可不止一颗葡萄干。

sentences.en: And I didn't think particularly about whether I wanted that raisin or needed that raisin or whether that raisin was going to fill me up.
sentences.zh: 而且我并没有特别去想我是否想要那颗葡萄干，或者是否需要那颗葡萄干，或者那颗葡萄干是否能让我饱腹。

sentences.en: I used to ignore a lot of messages that I was getting from my body, and those messages might have told me to slow down, might have told me to eat less,
sentences.zh: 我过去常常忽略身体发出的许多信号，这些信号可能是在提醒我慢下来，提醒我少吃点，

sentences.en: but I couldn't afford to listen to them.
sentences.zh: 但我根本无法听进去。

sentences.en: And if I had continued that way, it would have been a disaster for me.
sentences.zh: 如果我继续那样下去，对我来说将是一场灾难。

sentences.en: I was in so much trouble from basically pretending that I could eat and eat and eat with no consequence.
sentences.zh: 我当时陷入了巨大的麻烦，基本上是因为我假装自己可以毫无节制地吃下去。

sentences.en: So that's really what I wanted you to come here and talk about, those consequences and what you have done to address them.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我真正想让你来谈谈的原因，关于那些后果以及你为了解决它们所做的事情。

sentences.en: So I wonder if you could go back to the beginning of all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想知道你能不能回到这一切的起点。

sentences.en: How did this start for you?
sentences.zh: 这一切是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: Well, on New Year's Day, 2024, I was sitting in a sauna with a doctor.
sentences.zh: 嗯，2024年元旦那天，我和一位医生坐在桑拿房里。

sentences.en: I was at a party, the doctor was at the party, and the host of the party has a sauna in the back of his house.
sentences.zh: 我在参加一个聚会，医生也在，聚会的主人在他家后院有个桑拿房。

sentences.en: So I was sitting there in my bathing suit chatting with this guy about, oh, how the health industry is changing and how journalism is changing.
sentences.zh: 所以我穿着泳衣坐在那儿，和这家伙聊着健康产业和新闻业是如何变化的。

sentences.en: And I thought we were having a perfectly pleasant conversation, and I had charmed him.
sentences.zh: 我以为我们聊得非常愉快，而且我迷住了他。

sentences.en: No doubt.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Two days later, my phone rang, and the host of the party said,
sentences.zh: 两天后，我的电话响了，聚会的主人说，

sentences.en: Do you remember that doctor you were talking to?
sentences.zh: 你还记得和你聊天的那个医生吗？

sentences.en: The one you charmed?
sentences.zh: 那个被你迷住的医生？

sentences.en: I said, yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 我说，记得，当然。

sentences.en: Well, he's very concerned about you, and he's looked at you and thought there was a possibility that you might have something,
sentences.zh: 嗯，他非常担心你，他观察了你，认为你可能患有某种疾病，

sentences.en: and if you do have it, you could drop dead at any minute.
sentences.zh: 如果真的患有，你随时可能会猝死。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Based on simply being in a sauna with you.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为和你一起蒸了桑拿？

sentences.en: Looking at my stomach.
sentences.zh: 看着我的肚子。

sentences.en: This doctor had determined.
sentences.zh: 这位医生做出了判断。

sentences.en: Looking at my gut, which had just gotten bigger and bigger, and I had a hernia just above my belly button, and I knew I had to.
sentences.zh: 看着我的肚子，它变得越来越大，我的肚脐上方有个疝气，我知道我必须……

sentences.en: And here you thought he'd been looking in your eyes the whole time.
sentences.zh: 而你还以为他一直盯着你的眼睛看呢。

sentences.en: And it was not the encounter that I thought I was having.
sentences.zh: 那次会面并不是我想象的那样。

sentences.en: But he looked at that, and he knew there was a chance it was a hernia, but he also thought there was a chance that it was cirrhosis,
sentences.zh: 但他看到了那个，他知道有可能是疝气，但也认为有可能是肝硬化，

sentences.en: that my liver was so diseased that it was starting to manifest in my external appearance.
sentences.zh: 我的肝脏病变严重，以至于开始在我的外表上显现出来。

sentences.en: And so a couple weeks later, I was sitting in a doctor's office for the first time in a few years.
sentences.zh: 所以几周后，我几年来第一次坐在了医生的办公室里。

sentences.en: You hadn't been getting annual physicals?
sentences.zh: 你之前没做过年度体检吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, COVID happened, and I couldn't get in to see my doctor when I really wanted to.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，新冠疫情发生了，我想看医生时却看不了。

sentences.en: And then after that, I just kind of got in, and I was feeling relatively okay.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我就凑合着过，感觉还相对不错。

sentences.en: And, you know, years ago, when I first started reviewing restaurants, I went to my doctor, and I needed a colonoscopy, so I went in.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，几年前，当我刚开始做餐厅评论时，我去看医生，需要做肠镜检查，所以我去了。

sentences.en: And just as the anesthesiologist was about to put me under, my doctor says to him, you know what this guy does for a living?
sentences.zh: 就在麻醉师准备让我进入麻醉状态时，我的医生对他说，你知道这家伙是干什么的吗？

sentences.en: He's the restaurant critic of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 他是《纽约时报》的餐厅评论家。

sentences.en: Can you believe that?
sentences.zh: 你能相信吗？

sentences.en: And then they proceeded to, you know, go and look around my gut.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就开始，你知道，去检查我的肠道了。

sentences.en: But, you know, that doctor said, your colon's fine, you're a little bit overweight, but hey, given what you do, that's to be expected.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那个医生说，你的结肠没问题，稍微有点超重，但嘿，考虑到你的工作，这是意料之中的。

sentences.en: And I kind of took that as a green light to just do what I needed to do and do what I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我把这当作了绿灯，去做我需要做和想做的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And now suddenly, a different doctor, a few years later, has rendered a rather different verdict.
sentences.zh: 而现在，几年后，另一位医生给出了截然不同的诊断。

sentences.en: Yeah, and he says, you need to stop what you're doing right now.
sentences.zh: 是的，他说，你现在必须停止你正在做的事情。

sentences.en: So when I got my blood work back, the lab results from the hospital are sort of laid out in like green, yellow, and red, or, you know, fine, borderline, and bad.
sentences.zh: 当我拿到验血报告时，医院的化验结果是用绿色、黄色和红色标出的，也就是，你知道，正常、临界和糟糕。

sentences.en: And there was a lot of red on that page in cholesterol and triglycerides and blood sugar.
sentences.zh: 那张纸上有很多红色的指标，胆固醇、甘油三酯和血糖。

sentences.en: And even I, who know nothing about health and diet, knew that this was bad.
sentences.zh: 即使是我这种对健康和饮食一窍不通的人，也知道这很糟糕。

sentences.en: It was a couple days before I got the blood work back, but there was a note of concern in what he wrote, the commentary on it.
sentences.zh: 在我拿到验血报告的前几天，他写的评论里就流露出担忧。

sentences.en: And he said, you're pre-diabetic.
sentences.zh: 他说，你是糖尿病前期。

sentences.en: And that totally got my attention because I thought pre-diabetic sounds bad, but like diabetic, that sounds even worse.
sentences.zh: 这完全引起了我的注意，因为我觉得糖尿病前期听起来很糟糕，但像糖尿病，听起来更糟。

sentences.en: And I didn't really want to find out what would be entailed because I knew it wasn't good.
sentences.zh: 我真的不想去了解这意味着什么，因为我知道那不是什么好事。

sentences.en: And just to be clear on the chronology, at this point, you're still the restaurant critic at the Times.
sentences.zh: 为了理清时间线，在这一点上，你仍然是《时报》的餐厅评论家。

sentences.en: You're eating out, what, four or five nights plus a week?
sentences.zh: 你每周外出就餐，大概四五次以上？

sentences.en: At this point that we're talking about even more than that because I was working on a list of the hundred greatest restaurants in New York.
sentences.zh: 在我们谈论的这个阶段，甚至比那还要多，因为我正在制作一份纽约百大餐厅名单。

sentences.en: And that was my idea.
sentences.zh: 那是我的主意。

sentences.en: I thought it was important to do it, but it was so much more punishing than I expected because I would say like, well,
sentences.zh: 我觉得做这件事很重要，但它比我预想的要折磨人得多，因为我会说，嗯，

sentences.en: if I wanted to say that somebody had the best cheese pierogies, I would probably at that time have gone around and tried 10 cheese pierogies around the city.
sentences.zh: 如果我想说某家店有最好的奶酪波兰饺子，我当时可能会跑遍全城去尝试10家奶酪波兰饺子。

sentences.en: It just, it led me into much more eating than I had anticipated so that I could really feel like I could stand behind my choices.
sentences.zh: 这导致我吃的比预想的要多得多，这样我才能真正觉得我有底气支持我的选择。

sentences.en: So at this point, I was probably eating more than in a short period of time than I ever had in my life.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个阶段，我吃的量可能是我一生中短时间内吃得最多的。

sentences.en: So just as you're receiving some pretty serious information about your health, that you're kind of in crisis,
sentences.zh: 所以就在你收到关于你健康状况的严重信息，意识到自己处于危机中时，

sentences.en: you realize that you have to keep slogging through these 100 restaurants.
sentences.zh: 你意识到你必须继续硬着头皮完成这100家餐厅的测评。

sentences.en: I slogged.
sentences.zh: 我硬着头皮完成了。

sentences.en: I slogged.
sentences.zh: 我硬着头皮完成了。

sentences.en: The only thing I could do at that moment was to change how I ate at home, but I wasn't eating at home very much because I was just out around the city, all five boroughs,
sentences.zh: 我当时唯一能做的就是改变我在家里的饮食方式，但我并没有在家吃多少，因为我一直在城里到处跑，跑遍了所有五个行政区，

sentences.en: trying to cover it all.
sentences.zh: 试图把它们都覆盖到。

sentences.en: But by the time I was done with that, it was clear that I needed to change more than just what I ate at home.
sentences.zh: 但当我完成这一切时，很明显我需要改变的不仅仅是在家的饮食。

sentences.en: I really needed to change my job.
sentences.zh: 我真的需要换一份工作。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And give up a job you presumably love, not to mention one of the most prestigious jobs in journalism, let alone food journalism.
sentences.zh: 放弃一份你理应热爱的工作，更不用说这是新闻界，尤其是美食新闻界最负盛名的工作之一。

sentences.en: How do you make that decision?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做出那个决定的？

sentences.en: Oh, it was a great job.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是一份很棒的工作。

sentences.en: And I don't think I could have made that decision without being scared for my life.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得如果不是因为担心自己的生命安全，我不可能做出那个决定。

sentences.en: The only way that I was ever going to leave there was if I got fired or dropped dead, you know.
sentences.zh: 我离开那里的唯一方式就是被解雇或者猝死，你知道的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I thought for about five minutes about whether I could really make the changes I needed to make while continuing to do the job, and it just didn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 我花了大约五分钟时间思考，是否可以在继续做这份工作的同时，真正做出我需要做出的改变，但这根本说不通。

sentences.en: It didn't make any sense at all.
sentences.zh: 这完全说不通。

sentences.en: How do I go into a restaurant and avoid carbohydrates?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能去餐厅却避开碳水化合物呢？

sentences.en: How do I avoid bread?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能避开面包呢？

sentences.en: How do I avoid sugar?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能避开糖呢？

sentences.en: I thought about it, and then I thought, I don't see how I can do it.
sentences.zh: 我考虑了一下，然后我想，我看不出我该怎么做。

sentences.en: And part of the way I used to do the job, and I think anybody doing the job would agree with this, is you do need to give yourself over to the joy of the food.
sentences.zh: 而且我过去做这份工作的方式，我想任何做这份工作的人都会同意这一点，那就是你需要全身心地投入到食物的乐趣中去。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, beyond the need to taste everything, which you do, you have a professional obligation as a restaurant critic to do right by the menu.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，除了你必须品尝一切的需求之外，作为一名餐厅评论家，你还有职业义务去公正地对待菜单上的每一道菜。

sentences.en: You can't suddenly become the guy ordering vegan, ordering just the healthy foods.
sentences.zh: 你不能突然变成那种只点纯素食、只点健康食品的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: My philosophy about restaurant criticism was always that I should be a reporter on the frontiers of pleasure, and here's what's out there.
sentences.zh: 我关于餐厅评论的哲学一直是：我应该是快乐前沿的报道者，向大家展示外面有什么好吃的。

sentences.en: And whether that's good for me or not doesn't come into the picture.
sentences.zh: 至于这对我的身体好不好，那不在考虑范围内。

sentences.en: A lot of times, you know, I would usually bring people along with me, not to help me eat, but to make it look less crazy when I was sitting there at a table full of food,
sentences.zh: 很多时候，你知道，我通常会带人一起去，不是为了让他们帮我吃，而是为了让我在坐在一桌食物前时看起来没那么疯狂，

sentences.en: half the menu, right in front of me.
sentences.zh: 面前摆着半份菜单，对吧。

sentences.en: I didn't need the other people to eat it, but it just wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我并不需要别人帮我吃，但如果不带人……

sentences.en: They were a cover.
sentences.zh: 他们是掩护。

sentences.en: Yeah, they were a cover, right?
sentences.zh: 没错，他们是掩护，对吧？

sentences.en: So, and occasionally, I would go with a new person who didn't know the drill, and they would look at the menu and say, you know, I think I'm going to have the salad.
sentences.zh: 所以，偶尔我会带一个不懂规矩的新人，他们看着菜单说，你知道吗，我想点个沙拉。

sentences.en: I'm going to have the salad.
sentences.zh: 我要点沙拉。

sentences.en: And I say, okay, you can have the salad, but you're also getting the pork chop, and you're getting the cannoli.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，你可以点沙拉，但你还得吃猪排，还得吃奶油甜馅煎饼卷。

sentences.en: You're on a Simon here.
sentences.zh: 你现在是在西蒙的规则下。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'd sometimes be there with civilians who are trying to eat in a normal way, and I was like, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 有时我会和那些试图正常吃饭的普通人在一起，我会想，你们在干什么？

sentences.en: That is not what happens here.
sentences.zh: 这里可不兴这一套。

sentences.en: So you decide you've got to walk away from this job, and I have to imagine that that's hard.
sentences.zh: 所以你决定放弃这份工作，我能想象这一定很难。

sentences.en: It's hard because what else am I ever going to do that'll be as good as that?
sentences.zh: 很难，因为我还能做什么能像那份工作一样好呢？

sentences.en: A lot went with it, too.
sentences.zh: 而且那份工作还伴随着很多其他东西。

sentences.en: That sort of my entire social life had migrated into my job.
sentences.zh: 我整个社交生活似乎都迁移到了我的工作中。

sentences.en: Probably people came out and spent time with me who would not have come to my apartment.
sentences.zh: 可能有些人会出来和我待在一起，但他们绝不会来我的公寓。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: You've become like the one kid in high school who has a car.
sentences.zh: 你就像高中里那个有车的孩子。

sentences.en: Like, you can never quite tell, am I really this popular?
sentences.zh: 就像，你永远无法确定，我真的这么受欢迎吗？

sentences.en: Or is it just the car?
sentences.zh: 还是仅仅因为那辆车？

sentences.en: Or is it my Ford Tempo?
sentences.zh: 还是因为我的福特天霸？

sentences.en: So all of a sudden, you're, I presume, at home every night?
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，我猜你每天晚上都在家？

sentences.en: Yes, every night.
sentences.zh: 是的，每天晚上。

sentences.en: Cooking?
sentences.zh: 自己做饭？

sentences.en: Cooking.
sentences.zh: 自己做饭。

sentences.en: Making whatever was the right thing for me to be eating.
sentences.zh: 做些适合我吃的东西。

sentences.en: And I had to figure out what that was and how to do it.
sentences.zh: 我得弄清楚那是什么，以及该怎么做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, that is what we're going to explore right after a quick break.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这正是我们稍作休息后要探讨的内容。

sentences.en: Like, exactly how you reset your entire relationship to food.
sentences.zh: 比如，你究竟是如何重塑你与食物的整个关系的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是 Wena Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Mazursky。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: So, Pete, you're trying to figure out how to change your diet.
sentences.zh: 那么，皮特，你正在设法改变你的饮食习惯。

sentences.en: So what do you tackle first?
sentences.zh: 那你首先要解决什么？

sentences.en: Because I was so concerned about blood sugar, I went for the simple carbohydrates firSt.
sentences.zh: 因为我非常担心血糖，所以我首先选择了简单的碳水化合物。

sentences.en: By which we mean?
sentences.zh: 我们指的是？

sentences.en: Well, sugar, obviously.
sentences.zh: 嗯，显然是糖。

sentences.en: White flour, especially.
sentences.zh: 尤其是白面粉。

sentences.en: White rice, I was concerned about.
sentences.zh: 白米饭，我也很担心。

sentences.en: All these foods that release energy really, really quickly, cause blood sugar spikes, and then ultimately make you hungrier.
sentences.zh: 所有这些能非常非常快地释放能量、导致血糖飙升，并最终让你更饿的食物。

sentences.en: Like pasta.
sentences.zh: 比如意大利面。

sentences.en: Pasta.
sentences.zh: 意大利面。

sentences.en: Love pasta.
sentences.zh: 我爱意大利面。

sentences.en: It was gone.
sentences.zh: 它被剔除了。

sentences.en: Well.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: You know, so all, a lot of things that I love, a great loaf of bread, you know, there's mediocre bread and there's great bread.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我爱很多东西，比如一条很棒的面包，你知道，面包有平庸的，也有很棒的。

sentences.en: And when you get the great bread, it's like, oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 当你吃到很棒的面包时，你会想，哦，谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for doing this.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你做出这样的面包。

sentences.en: A cookie.
sentences.zh: 还有饼干。

sentences.en: A good cookie, you know.
sentences.zh: 好吃的饼干，你知道的。

sentences.en: So, all of that, all of it, I just kicked it out of the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有这些，全部，我直接把它们踢出了厨房。

sentences.en: Beyond pasta, what was the hardest of these to give up on?
sentences.zh: 除了意大利面，放弃这些东西里最难的是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, sugar.
sentences.zh: 哦，糖。

sentences.en: Sugar, I mean, sugar is so delicious, right?
sentences.zh: 糖，我的意思是，糖太美味了，对吧？

sentences.en: And I was, every morning I would wake up and I would drink five or six cups of coffee and each one would get a teaspoon of sugar.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上醒来都会喝五六杯咖啡，每一杯都要加一茶匙糖。

sentences.en: The teaspoons got a little more rounded as time went on.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，那茶匙里的糖堆得越来越圆了。

sentences.en: And I was drinking.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直在喝。

sentences.en: So, you're having essentially five or six teaspoons of sugar a morning.
sentences.zh: 所以，你早上基本上要摄入五到六茶匙的糖。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What is it like just to use this microcosm when that coffee is sugarless and when there is no pasta and no cookie?
sentences.zh: 用这个微观视角来看，当咖啡不加糖，也没有意大利面和饼干时，感觉如何？

sentences.en: What I discovered giving them up was I gave them up because of the blood sugar, right?
sentences.zh: 我放弃它们时发现，我放弃它们是因为血糖，对吧？

sentences.en: It's almost literal, like your blood sugar is too high, eat less sugar.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是字面意思，就像你的血糖太高了，那就少吃糖。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But what I discovered as I gave it up was that my mind cleared.
sentences.zh: 但我放弃它后发现，我的头脑变清醒了。

sentences.en: It, it, I didn't even understand what was happening for a while, but my, my mind was clearing.
sentences.zh: 它……有一段时间我甚至不明白发生了什么，但我的头脑确实在变清醒。

sentences.en: I didn't have all these voices shouting at me like, hey, it's cookie time.
sentences.zh: 我不再有那些声音对我大喊大叫，比如，嘿，该吃饼干了。

sentences.en: Hey, it's time for another spoonful of sugar in the coffee.
sentences.zh: 嘿，该往咖啡里再加一勺糖了。

sentences.en: Well, you know, what, what people now call food noise.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，人们现在称之为“食物噪音”。

sentences.en: I was surrounded by it and a lot of it just cleared up, went away as I ate fewer simple carbs.
sentences.zh: 我被它包围着，当我少吃简单碳水化合物时，很多噪音就消失了。

sentences.en: I didn't understand how much the things I was eating were contributing to my cravings for more and more and more.
sentences.zh: 我以前没意识到，我吃的东西在多大程度上助长了我对更多、更多、更多食物的渴望。

sentences.en: That's just a vast hunger that I felt almost all the time was being produced by food.
sentences.zh: 那种我几乎一直感受到的巨大饥饿感，其实是由食物制造出来的。

sentences.en: By what you were putting in your system.
sentences.zh: 由你摄入体内的东西制造的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So talk about what you were starting to eat instead, what you were supplanting all of these simple sugars, these carbohydrates with.
sentences.zh: 那说说你开始吃什么来代替，你用什么来取代所有这些简单糖分和碳水化合物的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I'm drinking my coffee black and kind of liking it more and more as time goes on.
sentences.zh: 我现在喝黑咖啡，随着时间的推移，我越来越喜欢它了。

sentences.en: I was eating a lot of fruit, ripe fruit in the summer and then the rest of the year, dried fruit.
sentences.zh: 我吃很多水果，夏天吃新鲜成熟的水果，一年中剩下的时间吃干果。

sentences.en: I mean, I love dates and they have so much sugar in them,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我爱椰枣，它们含有大量的糖分，

sentences.en: but it was an okay form of sugar for me because it wasn't the kind that was going to like spike my blood sugar right away and make me run like a, like a rat in a wheel.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说这是一种可以接受的糖分形式，因为它不会像其他糖那样让我的血糖瞬间飙升，让我像笼子里的老鼠一样乱跑。

sentences.en: Well, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，

sentences.en: I was figuring out without exactly understanding why that like fruits in their natural state before they've been reduced to sugar are actually food and that food satisfies you.
sentences.zh: 我当时在没完全明白原因的情况下发现，水果在自然状态下，在还没被提炼成糖之前，其实就是食物，而食物能让你满足。

sentences.en: And in a way that all of this extracted sugar just never did.
sentences.zh: 这种满足感是所有这些提取出来的糖永远无法给予的。

sentences.en: What about meat?
sentences.zh: 那肉类呢？

sentences.en: Oh, well, meat, I had to bring down the cholesterol, you know, what we're talking about, the bad cholesterol, whatever that is, you know, I had to bring that down.
sentences.zh: 哦，嗯，肉类，我得降低胆固醇，你知道我们在说什么，坏胆固醇，不管那是什么，我得把它降下来。

sentences.en: So I, I threw almost all animal products overboard, even chicken, which isn't that bad.
sentences.zh: 所以我几乎抛弃了所有动物产品，甚至鸡肉，虽然它没那么糟糕。

sentences.en: You know, you know, one of the hardest things to give up was chicken skin, chicken skin on a roast chicken.
sentences.zh: 你知道，放弃最难的事情之一就是鸡皮，烤鸡上的鸡皮。

sentences.en: It's so good, but apparently there's cholesterol in there.
sentences.zh: 它太好吃了，但显然里面有胆固醇。

sentences.en: I never knew this and I had to put something in the place of all this meat.
sentences.zh: 我以前从不知道这一点，我必须用别的东西来代替所有这些肉。

sentences.en: I wasn't eating anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不再吃肉了。

sentences.en: And that turns out to be sometimes fish, but a lot more often plants, vegetables, beans, lentils, broccoli.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，有时是鱼，但更多时候是植物，蔬菜、豆类、扁豆、西兰花。

sentences.en: Kale, stuff that I liked already, but I had never really made it the focus of my meal.
sentences.zh: 羽衣甘蓝，这些我本来就喜欢的东西，但我从未真正把它们作为餐食的重点。

sentences.en: So as vegetables especially became so much more central to my diet, I was no longer really happy going to the grocery store on my corner,
sentences.zh: 所以，随着蔬菜在我的饮食中变得越来越重要，我不再乐意去街角的杂货店了，

sentences.en: which is very convenient and not all that expensive.
sentences.zh: 虽然那里很方便，也不太贵。

sentences.en: But the produce section, it's, it's not why anyone's going there.
sentences.zh: 但那里的农产品区，根本不是大家去那里的原因。

sentences.en: And so, you know, in search of better, fresher, brighter, more colorful, tastier vegetables,
sentences.zh: 所以，为了寻找更好、更新鲜、更明亮、更多彩、更美味的蔬菜，

sentences.en: I ended up spending a lot more time at my food co-op than I ever had before, which is full of great vegetables, full of dried beans, full of dried grains,
sentences.zh: 我最终花在食品合作社的时间比以前多得多，那里有很棒的蔬菜，有干豆，有干谷物，

sentences.en: full of most of the stuff that I want to be eating.
sentences.zh: 有大部分我想吃的东西。

sentences.en: It essentially doesn't have a lot of the stuff that I'm not going to be eating anyway, or that I don't even want to think about.
sentences.zh: 它基本上没有很多我本来就不会吃，或者我甚至不想去想的东西。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So you go into a typical American supermarket, there are so many things in the aisles and these bright packages.
sentences.zh: 所以你走进一家典型的美国超市，货架上有那么多东西，还有那些明亮的包装。

sentences.en: Like a dietary casino.
sentences.zh: 就像一个饮食赌场。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Cereal boxes stacked up to the sky that you couldn't possibly miss.
sentences.zh: 堆得高高的麦片盒，你不可能错过。

sentences.en: It's just all in your face trying to get your attention.
sentences.zh: 它们就在你眼前，试图吸引你的注意力。

sentences.en: It's, it's just like walking through the slot machines, like bing, bing, bing, bing, bing, bing, bing, bing.
sentences.zh: 这就像走过老虎机，叮、叮、叮、叮、叮、叮、叮、叮。

sentences.en: And like, co-op is not like that.
sentences.zh: 而合作社不是那样的。

sentences.en: It is a much more, it is a much more somber experience.
sentences.zh: 那是一种更……那是一种更严肃的体验。

sentences.en: I mean, they're friendly, but it's not a pinball machine of joy, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们很友好，但那不是一台快乐的弹球机，你知道的。

sentences.en: So among the many changes you're making here is where and how you shop for groceries.
sentences.zh: 所以，你正在做的许多改变中，包括你在哪里以及如何购买杂货。

sentences.en: It starts to fit together that if I, you know, shop in a place and in a manner that's sort of geared toward like what I ultimately want to eat.
sentences.zh: 这开始变得协调起来，如果我以一种旨在满足我最终想吃的东西的方式去购物。

sentences.en: And if I walk in there with a plan and a list and an idea of like, here are the things that I want to eat this week.
sentences.zh: 如果我带着计划、清单和想法走进那里，比如，这是我这周想吃的东西。

sentences.en: It becomes a different, a different approach to shopping, which where like, you know,
sentences.zh: 这变成了一种不同的购物方式，不像以前，你知道，

sentences.en: I might have in the old days waited until it was like 730 and the supermarket was about to close.
sentences.zh: 我可能在过去会等到七点半，超市快关门的时候才去。

sentences.en: And then I'd run in there and I was sort of in a panic and I was already like getting really, really hungry.
sentences.zh: 然后我冲进去，处于一种恐慌状态，而且已经饿得不行了。

sentences.en: And I would just start grabbing stuff like what, what's quick, what's easy, what's, what can I get on the table?
sentences.zh: 我就会开始乱抓东西，什么快，什么容易，什么能马上端上桌？

sentences.en: And boy, all those cookies are quick, quick, quick, quick.
sentences.zh: 天哪，那些饼干真是快，快，快，快。

sentences.en: And I put in some ice cream for later, just in case, just in case, right?
sentences.zh: 我还放了一些冰淇淋以备后用，以防万一，以防万一，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's different when you go into it with cold blood, with a plan.
sentences.zh: 当你冷静地带着计划去购物时，情况就不同了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And once all this food comes home with you from the co-op, what are you doing differently with it?
sentences.zh: 一旦所有这些食物从合作社带回家，你对它们有什么不同的处理方式吗？

sentences.en: I'm trying partly to put things that I want to eat more of right in front of me, like where, where I'll, I'll see them.
sentences.zh: 我试图把我想多吃的东西放在我面前，放在我能看到的地方。

sentences.en: So, so if I have raspberries that I've just brought home, they go in the refrigerator right at eye level.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我刚带回覆盆子，它们就会放在冰箱里视线平齐的地方。

sentences.en: So I remember to eat them before they go moldy and squishy and, you know, turn into raspberry soup.
sentences.zh: 这样我就能记得在它们发霉、变软、变成覆盆子汤之前吃掉它们。

sentences.en: And then there's a, I've got basically one cabinet in my kitchen where I can keep food.
sentences.zh: 然后，我的厨房里基本上只有一个柜子可以放食物。

sentences.en: And I would put all the almonds and the peanuts and the pistachios and the dried fruit right at eye level.
sentences.zh: 我会把所有的杏仁、花生、开心果和干果放在视线平齐的地方。

sentences.en: And there's, so when I open it up, there it is.
sentences.zh: 所以当我打开柜子时，它们就在那里。

sentences.en: You have a handful of almonds.
sentences.zh: 你抓一把杏仁吃。

sentences.en: You don't.
sentences.zh: 你不会（乱吃别的）。

sentences.en: You're saying kind of geography is destiny in your kitchen.
sentences.zh: 你是说在你的厨房里，地理位置决定了命运。

sentences.en: Well, I think most people eat what's right in front of them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为大多数人吃的是摆在他们面前的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, my eye keeps going back to this box of raisins, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我的目光总是回到这盒葡萄干上，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't know about yours, but like, I'm sort of like, oh, there was raisins here.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你的情况，但我会想，哦，这里有葡萄干。

sentences.en: If they were cookies, that's what I'd be staring at.
sentences.zh: 如果它们是饼干，那我就只会盯着它们看。

sentences.en: And if they're almonds, that's where I'll stare at.
sentences.zh: 如果它们是杏仁，那我就盯着杏仁看。

sentences.en: There might be almonds that aren't quite as enticing, but they become enticing when they're the only thing around.
sentences.zh: 可能有些杏仁没那么诱人，但当周围只有它们时，它们就变得诱人了。

sentences.en: For those who are curious, what is a typical dinner plate looking like in this new regime?
sentences.zh: 对于好奇的人，在这种新饮食模式下，典型的餐盘是什么样的？

sentences.en: Oh, well, the other day I made a salad.
sentences.zh: 哦，嗯，那天我做了个沙拉。

sentences.en: So I had some lentils that I had already cooked.
sentences.zh: 我有一些煮好的扁豆。

sentences.en: And I didn't want to just eat lentils because, you know, it's a little penitential.
sentences.zh: 我不想只吃扁豆，因为你知道，那有点像在苦修。

sentences.en: It's a little bit like, what have I done wrong to deserve this?
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是，我做错了什么才落得如此下场？

sentences.en: So I dressed them up with some lemon juice and olive oil,
sentences.zh: 所以我用柠檬汁和橄榄油给它们调了味，

sentences.en: and then I shaved some carrots into these thin little coins and chopped some radicchio into like ribbons and mixed that all up.
sentences.zh: 然后把胡萝卜削成薄薄的小圆片，把菊苣切成丝，把这些全都拌在一起。

sentences.en: And then the lemon and olive oil just gave it some life.
sentences.zh: 柠檬和橄榄油让它瞬间有了活力。

sentences.en: And I felt pretty good about that.
sentences.zh: 我对那顿饭感觉还不错。

sentences.en: That was dinner.
sentences.zh: 那就是晚餐。

sentences.en: That was great.
sentences.zh: 非常棒。

sentences.en: You know, back when I was eating a lot of meat, I would have wanted some sausages to go with that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以前我吃很多肉的时候，我会想配点香肠一起吃。

sentences.en: I was going to say, you know what would go really well with that?
sentences.zh: 我正想说，你知道什么和那个搭配起来特别好吗？

sentences.en: Obviously.
sentences.zh: 显而易见。

sentences.en: Roasted chicken with skin.
sentences.zh: 带皮的烤鸡。

sentences.en: Anything.
sentences.zh: 什么都行。

sentences.en: You know, I've been eating the lentils with smoked trout, and that's great.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一直在吃配烟熏鳟鱼的扁豆，那味道很棒。

sentences.en: You know, smoked trout, maybe with like a horseradish mayonnaise or a mustard, and then the lentils underneath or something.
sentences.zh: 你知道，烟熏鳟鱼，可能再配点辣根蛋黄酱或芥末，下面铺上扁豆之类的。

sentences.en: So nice about that combination.
sentences.zh: 那种组合真是太美妙了。

sentences.en: I mean, you're resetting your pleasure sensors.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你正在重置你的愉悦感官。

sentences.en: Well, all those sensors, they were always working, and they were always sending messages.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所有那些感官，它们一直都在工作，也一直都在发送信息。

sentences.en: But, you know, like the raisins, you were probably getting all of that data from the raisin in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，就像葡萄干一样，你过去可能从葡萄干那里得到了所有那些数据。

sentences.en: But when you slow down and you register those impressions, like actually take in the data that you're being given.
sentences.zh: 但当你慢下来，去记录那些印象时，就像真正地去接收你所获得的数据一样。

sentences.en: And I was finding this as I changed the way I ate, that like the lentils, if they have the right partner, they are enough.
sentences.zh: 我发现当我改变饮食方式时，比如扁豆，如果它们有合适的搭档，它们就足够了。

sentences.en: And not just enough, but actually kind of wonderful.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是足够，实际上还相当美妙。

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to take another quick break.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们要再休息一下。

sentences.en: And when we come back, I want to talk about something we haven't yet covered, something I'm very invested in understanding, your changing relationship to alcohol.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我想聊聊我们还没涉及的话题，一个我非常想深入了解的话题：你与酒精之间不断变化的关系。

sentences.en: This break brought to you by the lentil council.
sentences.zh: 本次休息由扁豆委员会赞助播出。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So, Pete, this entire conversation, I have related to a lot of the things that you have been talking about.
sentences.zh: 那么，皮特，整个谈话中，我与你提到的很多事情都产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: But none more so than when you said that your doctor told you that your triglycerides were on the higher end.
sentences.zh: 但最让我感同身受的，是你提到医生说你的甘油三酯偏高。

sentences.en: Because I just got that information.
sentences.zh: 因为我刚收到这个消息。

sentences.en: Oh, you did?
sentences.zh: 哦，是吗？

sentences.en: Myself, from my doctor, not super high, but higher than they want.
sentences.zh: 我自己，从医生那里得知的，不是特别高，但比他们希望的要高。

sentences.en: I think, to use the metaphor, you did the yellow zone.
sentences.zh: 我想，用那个比喻来说，你进入了黄色区域。

sentences.en: And I am pretty sure I know precisely why that is.
sentences.zh: 而且我很确定我知道原因是什么。

sentences.en: And it's because of my affection for cocktails.
sentences.zh: 是因为我太爱喝鸡尾酒了。

sentences.en: Cocktails are great.
sentences.zh: 鸡尾酒很棒。

sentences.en: And I have to imagine that changing your relationship to booze, to wine, has been a relatively important part of this experience for you.
sentences.zh: 我不得不认为，改变你与酒精、与葡萄酒的关系，对你来说是这次经历中相对重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Oh, it's been a major change.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是一个重大的改变。

sentences.en: Major change.
sentences.zh: 重大的改变。

sentences.en: Because I rarely drink now.
sentences.zh: 因为我现在很少喝酒了。

sentences.en: And in the old days, I drank almost every night.
sentences.zh: 而在过去，我几乎每天晚上都喝。

sentences.en: And a lot.
sentences.zh: 而且喝很多。

sentences.en: A lot.
sentences.zh: 很多。

sentences.en: What's a lot?
sentences.zh: 多少算很多？

sentences.en: More than I realized.
sentences.zh: 比我意识到的还要多。

sentences.en: Well, you know, cocktail when you sit down.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，坐下来就喝杯鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: And then a bottle of wine, if I'm with other people.
sentences.zh: 如果我和别人在一起，就会喝一瓶葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Sometimes it would be two bottles, sometimes three.
sentences.zh: 有时是两瓶，有时三瓶。

sentences.en: It really adds up.
sentences.zh: 真的积少成多。

sentences.en: And I think I was probably a little bit hungover every single morning without quite registering what it was.
sentences.zh: 我想我每天早上可能都有点宿醉，只是没太意识到那是什么感觉。

sentences.en: I didn't feel great.
sentences.zh: 我感觉不太好。

sentences.en: I woke up feeling unrested.
sentences.zh: 我醒来时感觉没休息好。

sentences.en: I didn't have headaches.
sentences.zh: 我没有头痛。

sentences.en: Part of the reason I wanted that sugar in the coffee so badly, like the dessert at the end of a disappointing meal, the alcohol can also help smooth over a lot of mediocrity.
sentences.zh: 我那么渴望咖啡里加糖的部分原因，就像在令人失望的餐后吃甜点一样，酒精也可以帮助掩盖很多平庸。

sentences.en: You know, there's restaurants that I would go into to review.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有些餐厅我会去写评论。

sentences.en: And I would know almost after the first bite that it wasn't going to be a review.
sentences.zh: 我几乎在第一口之后就知道这顿饭不值得写评论了。

sentences.en: And the alcohol just is your companion in those lonely situations where you're going through the rest of the meal,
sentences.zh: 而在那些孤独的时刻，当你继续吃剩下的饭菜时，酒精就是你的伴侣，

sentences.en: knowing that nothing's going to come out of it while the martini is there to hold your hand.
sentences.zh: 明知这顿饭不会有什么惊喜，但马提尼就在那里陪着你。

sentences.en: And in so many other situations, too.
sentences.zh: 在许多其他情况下也是如此。

sentences.en: It is just a companion when you need one.
sentences.zh: 当你需要的时候，它就是一个伴侣。

sentences.en: And so what was it like to give that up?
sentences.zh: 那么，放弃它是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Surprisingly, because I had made this major shift from eating out almost all the time to eating at home all the time, it wasn't as traumatic as I would have thought.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，因为我已经从几乎总是外出就餐转变为总是居家饮食，所以并没有我想象中那么痛苦。

sentences.en: Because the way I drank in restaurants came from being in restaurants.
sentences.zh: 因为我在餐厅喝酒的方式源于身处餐厅的环境。

sentences.en: And when you're at home, you might have a glass of wine, but the sommelier's not refilling it while you're not even paying attention.
sentences.zh: 而在家里，你可能会喝一杯酒，但侍酒师不会在你没注意的时候就给你续杯。

sentences.en: So you have the experience of getting to the bottom of your glass of wine and having to think, should I have another glass?
sentences.zh: 所以你有机会喝完杯底的酒，然后不得不思考：我还要再来一杯吗？

sentences.en: In a restaurant, you don't have to make those decisions, right?
sentences.zh: 在餐厅里，你不需要做这些决定，对吧？

sentences.en: At home and without other people around, too.
sentences.zh: 在家里，而且周围没有其他人时，也是如此。

sentences.en: And this is a big part of what makes drinking, I think, the value of drinking is that it's great to share with your friends.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是饮酒的价值所在，那就是与朋友分享是很棒的。

sentences.en: It's great to raise a glass with people you like.
sentences.zh: 与你喜欢的人举杯共饮是很棒的。

sentences.en: Or strangers become a little less strange.
sentences.zh: 或者让陌生人变得不那么陌生。

sentences.en: Well, sometimes they get more strange after a couple of drinks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有时喝了几杯之后，他们反而变得更陌生了。

sentences.en: But, you know, and I don't so much have that going on for me at home.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我在家里并没有那种情况。

sentences.en: I'm mostly alone.
sentences.zh: 我大部分时间都是一个人。

sentences.en: I don't need to get to know myself any better.
sentences.zh: 我不需要更了解自己。

sentences.en: I already kind of know who this person is.
sentences.zh: 我已经知道自己是个什么样的人了。

sentences.en: I'm fine with not drinking at home.
sentences.zh: 我在家不喝酒也没关系。

sentences.en: So when do you give yourself permission to drink?
sentences.zh: 那你什么时候允许自己喝酒呢？

sentences.en: With other people, if I have people over, if on the rare occasions I'm invited to someone else's home, and in restaurants, because it's something they do so well.
sentences.zh: 和别人在一起时，如果我邀请了客人，如果偶尔受邀去别人家，还有在餐厅里，因为那是他们擅长做的事情。

sentences.en: So now if I go to a restaurant, there's a chance I'll get a martini, especially at a place that I know does them well, which to me just means making them really cold.
sentences.zh: 所以现在如果我去餐厅，我可能会点一杯马提尼，尤其是在我知道他们做得好的地方，对我来说，这意味着做得非常冰。

sentences.en: That's basically all that matters as far as I'm concerned.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，这基本上就是最重要的。

sentences.en: You write about martinis in a way that I find to be poetic.
sentences.zh: 你写马提尼的方式让我觉得很有诗意。

sentences.en: You describe the way that first sip of a cold martini makes the hairs on the back of your neck stick up.
sentences.zh: 你描述了那第一口冰冷的马提尼让后颈汗毛竖起的感觉。

sentences.en: Oh, it's incredible.
sentences.zh: 哦，那真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: It's like getting an injection in your veins of some experimental drug that hits all your pleasure centers, right?
sentences.zh: 就像往血管里注射了一种能触动你所有愉悦中枢的实验性药物，对吧？

sentences.en: It's got to be, I don't know what it is, but I don't want to mess with it, and I don't want it to go away.
sentences.zh: 一定是的，我不知道那是什么，但我不想破坏它，也不想让它消失。

sentences.en: I just don't need it every night of my life.
sentences.zh: 我只是不需要每天晚上都喝。

sentences.en: And I find now, you know, anything that becomes habit, becomes routine,
sentences.zh: 我现在发现，你知道，任何成为习惯、成为常规的东西，

sentences.en: your brain sort of says, like, I don't need to be fully engaged here.
sentences.zh: 你的大脑会说，我不需要在这里完全投入。

sentences.en: I know what that's going to be.
sentences.zh: 我知道那会是什么样。

sentences.en: I know what a raisin tastes like.
sentences.zh: 我知道葡萄干是什么味道。

sentences.en: I don't need to pay attention to all the sensory data coming off that raisin.
sentences.zh: 我不需要去关注从那颗葡萄干中传来的所有感官数据。

sentences.en: And I don't need to pay attention to this martini, because there'll be another one tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我也不需要去关注这杯马提尼，因为明天还会有下一杯。

sentences.en: There was one last night.
sentences.zh: 昨晚也有一杯。

sentences.en: When you haven't seen a martini for a month or two, you can really focus on it.
sentences.zh: 当你一两个月没喝马提尼时，你真的可以专注于它。

sentences.en: You can really be, oh, gosh, look at that.
sentences.zh: 你可以真的感叹，哦，天哪，看看那个。

sentences.en: Look at the surface on there.
sentences.zh: 看看上面的表面。

sentences.en: A little bit of ice floating on there.
sentences.zh: 上面漂浮着一点点冰。

sentences.en: Mindful martini.
sentences.zh: 正念马提尼。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Maybe that's blasphemy.
sentences.zh: 也许那是亵渎。

sentences.en: But for me, I do think if you bring this mindfulness approach to your life, you don't only apply it to healthy things.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，我确实认为如果你把这种正念的方法带入生活，你不仅可以把它应用在健康的事情上。

sentences.en: You apply it to everything.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它应用在所有事情上。

sentences.en: You know, I'm trying to maintain, and maintaining means that I don't go back to my old way of living,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我正在努力维持，而维持意味着我不会回到以前的生活方式，

sentences.en: but it does mean I allow myself a lot of stuff that I just cut out in the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 但这确实意味着我允许自己享受很多我在刚开始时完全戒掉的东西。

sentences.en: I'll have a pastry sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我有时会吃点糕点。

sentences.en: I will have a martini sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我有时会喝杯马提尼。

sentences.en: I'll have a steak once in a while.
sentences.zh: 我偶尔会吃块牛排。

sentences.en: You know, but for me, it's nice to give myself all those indulgences in a restaurant setting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，但对我来说，在餐厅的环境里给自己这些放纵是很棒的。

sentences.en: So when I go out, I feel a little bit like, okay, we're not going to break all the rules at once.
sentences.zh: 所以当我出去时，我会觉得，好吧，我们不会一次打破所有规则。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But we'll break some of the rules, and that'll be part of the experience.
sentences.zh: 但我们会打破一些规则，那将成为体验的一部分。

sentences.en: So you are now eating occasionally back out at restaurants, and you are enjoying some booze.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在偶尔会回到餐厅吃饭，也会享受一些酒精。

sentences.en: And is that because you've reached a certain point of turning your health around?
sentences.zh: 这是因为你已经达到了扭转健康状况的某个节点吗？

sentences.en: Are you basically out of the red zone?
sentences.zh: 你基本上已经脱离危险区了吗？

sentences.en: I am not in crisis anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不再处于危机之中了。

sentences.en: Mazel tov.
sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Are you still pre-diabetic?
sentences.zh: 你还是糖尿病前期吗？

sentences.en: I am not.
sentences.zh: 不是了。

sentences.en: I've been told.
sentences.zh: 我是这么被告知的。

sentences.en: I mean, I could go back there, but I'm not there right now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我可能会回到那个状态，但我现在不在那里。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You've taken yourself out of that category.
sentences.zh: 你已经把自己从那个类别中移出来了。

sentences.en: I've been told, and other evidence suggests that I am no longer obese.
sentences.zh: 我是被告知的，其他证据也表明我不再肥胖了。

sentences.en: I mean, it's really impressive that you did all of this by your own design, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你完全靠自己的计划做到这一切，真的很令人印象深刻，对吧？

sentences.en: You didn't join any formal program, and you didn't...
sentences.zh: 你没有参加任何正式的计划，也没有……

sentences.en: I didn't use the drugs.
sentences.zh: 我没用那些药。

sentences.en: I didn't use the drugs.
sentences.zh: 我没用那些药。

sentences.en: I didn't get there.
sentences.zh: 我没到那一步。

sentences.en: I didn't get to the point...
sentences.zh: 我没到那个地步……

sentences.en: No exempt, no GLP-1.
sentences.zh: 没有司美格鲁肽，没有GLP-1。

sentences.en: No, right.
sentences.zh: 没有，没错。

sentences.en: So a lot of times when people go on those drugs, they've tried to diet, and sometimes they have not been able to stick to the diet.
sentences.zh: 所以很多时候，当人们使用那些药物时，是因为他们尝试过节食，有时却无法坚持下去。

sentences.en: Sometimes they've successfully dieted and then gained the weight back.
sentences.zh: 有时他们成功节食了，然后又反弹了。

sentences.en: That's super common.
sentences.zh: 这非常普遍。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That might happen to me.
sentences.zh: 那可能也会发生在我身上。

sentences.en: You know, I'm very aware of the possibility that I will gain this weight back.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我非常清楚自己可能会反弹的这种可能性。

sentences.en: I do feel like I've learned a lot of stuff about not just managing my diet, but managing myself and managing my behavior and managing my attitudes about food, that they feel like
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得我学到了很多东西，不仅是关于管理饮食，还有管理自己、管理行为以及管理我对食物的态度，这些感觉像是

sentences.en: long-term changes.
sentences.zh: 长期的改变。

sentences.en: It feels like knowledge that I now have that's changed the way I live.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是我现在掌握的知识，改变了我的生活方式。

sentences.en: And if all goes well, I should be able to just continue to approach food in this new way that I've come to.
sentences.zh: 如果一切顺利，我应该能够继续以这种我所领悟到的新方式来对待食物。

sentences.en: And you feel better.
sentences.zh: 而且你感觉更好了。

sentences.en: Well, that's to me...
sentences.zh: 嗯，对我来说……

sentences.en: Which is the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 这才是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: Way more important than how I look.
sentences.zh: 远比我的外表重要得多。

sentences.en: My mind is just brightened.
sentences.zh: 我的思绪豁然开朗。

sentences.en: My mind was always so heavy and underslept, confused, and just perpetually kind of groggy and grumpy, and it's wild, actually.
sentences.zh: 我的头脑以前总是昏昏沉沉、睡眠不足、困惑不堪，而且一直处于一种迷迷糊糊、脾气暴躁的状态，说实话，这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Like, sometimes you don't realize how bad you felt until you feel better.
sentences.zh: 就像有时候，你只有在感觉好转之后，才会意识到自己之前有多糟糕。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, now that you're on the other side of this all, I want to invite you to be a little bit philosophical about what you've been through.
sentences.zh: 好吧，既然你已经走出了那段日子，我想请你谈谈对这段经历的一些哲学思考。

sentences.en: Your relationship with food was always going to be a little bit different than the rest of us, to some degree, because of your job.
sentences.zh: 由于你的工作性质，你与食物的关系在某种程度上注定会与我们其他人有所不同。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm still a curious person, and I'm still a curious eater.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我仍然是一个充满好奇心的人，也是一个对食物充满好奇的食客。

sentences.en: What I have done is poured a lot of what I know about food and flavor and spices and different cuisines into making chickpeas interesting, right?
sentences.zh: 我所做的是，将我对食物、风味、香料和不同菜系的了解，倾注到如何让鹰嘴豆变得美味上，对吧？

sentences.en: One thing I've really appreciated about this sort of new chapter as a dedicated home cook is that it takes me out of my head.
sentences.zh: 作为一名专注的家庭厨师，我非常欣赏这个新篇章的一点是，它让我不再钻牛角尖。

sentences.en: And it's like physical activity that I live in while I'm working.
sentences.zh: 这就像是我工作时所处的一种身体活动。

sentences.en: It's all verbal.
sentences.zh: 一切都是口头的。

sentences.en: It's ideas and words and moving the words around and kind of logical, language-based thinking.
sentences.zh: 全是想法和词汇，在脑海中推敲词句，进行那种逻辑性的、基于语言的思考。

sentences.en: And then when I'm in the kitchen, I'm like chopping, and oh, don't get your finger too close to the edge of the knife.
sentences.zh: 而当我走进厨房时，我在切菜，噢，手指别离刀刃太近。

sentences.en: And how should I stand?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么站呢？

sentences.en: What's the most comfortable posture here?
sentences.zh: 什么样的姿势最舒服？

sentences.en: And oh, that's about to burn.
sentences.zh: 噢，那东西快要烧焦了。

sentences.en: I can't see it, but I can start to smell the scorching on the stove, and it's time to turn that over.
sentences.zh: 我看不见，但我能闻到炉子上烧焦的味道，是时候把它翻过来了。

sentences.en: All of these things where you're just, you're existing through your senses and through your body.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情，你只是通过感官和身体去感受当下的存在。

sentences.en: I find it like such a great relief from what I do in my job.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这对我平时的工作来说是一种极大的解脱。

sentences.en: And the pleasure of sitting in the restaurant is not the same as it's so passive, right?
sentences.zh: 坐在餐厅里享受美食的感觉是不一样的，那太被动了，对吧？

sentences.en: When I'm cooking now, and even when I'm eating, I feel like I'm doing something, which is somehow like really satisfying.
sentences.zh: 现在当我做饭，甚至吃饭的时候，我觉得自己在做些什么，这在某种程度上真的让人非常满足。

sentences.en: Just really appreciating how I can just feel like, here I am.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激自己能有这种感觉：我就在这里。

sentences.en: Here I am.
sentences.zh: 我就在这里。

sentences.en: Right here, right now.
sentences.zh: 就在此时，就在此地。

sentences.en: Feet planted on the ground.
sentences.zh: 双脚稳稳地踩在地上。

sentences.en: Feet planted on the ground, single raisin in front of me, what will I do with it?
sentences.zh: 双脚稳稳地踩在地上，面前放着一颗葡萄干，我该拿它怎么办呢？

sentences.en: Well, I am extremely happy for you, Pete, and I want to thank you so much for being here today.
sentences.zh: 好吧，皮特，我为你感到无比高兴，非常感谢你今天能来到这里。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yeah, I wasn't expecting any of this, but it's, uh, I'm glad to be here.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我没预料到会发生这些，但，呃，我很高兴能来到这里。

sentences.zh: 节目中包含了丹·鲍威尔、马里昂·洛萨诺和罗文·内米斯托的音乐。

sentences.zh: 我们的制作经理是弗兰妮·卡尔-托斯。

sentences.zh: 以上就是周日日报的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年

sentences.en: summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
